name: Rayris ~Mamono ni Haramasareta Saikyou no Onna Kishi~
original_name: レイリス～魔物に孕まされた最強の女騎士～
source:
The kingdom of Astoria is under grave threat by the resurrection of the Ancient Majyuu. 

As the top knight of the Order of Astoria, Rayris (protagonist/heroine) gives everything to suppress the demon horde and protect her princess. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125570.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阿斯托利亚王国因远古魔兽复活而面临严重威胁。

作为阿斯托利亚骑士团的首席骑士，蕾莉丝（主人公/女主角）竭尽全力镇压魔物大军，保护她的公主。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125570.html]DLsite English[/url]]
